# Verelios Labs

> Verelios Labs is a website, app and AI-automation agency based in Kanpur, India. We build custom websites, cross-platform mobile apps, and software, taking projects from idea to launch in under 3 weeks. Every engagement starts with a free mockup delivered within 48 hours and runs on milestone-based payment, so there is no large upfront cost.

Last updated: 2026-06-16

## Key facts

- **Name:** Verelios Labs (also "Verelios", "Verelios Web & App Studio")
- **Website:** https://www.verelios.com
- **What we do:** Custom website development, mobile app development (iOS + Android), custom software (ERP, CRM, APIs, automation), UI/UX design, e-commerce, performance optimization & SEO
- **Where:** Based in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh — 126/58 G Block, Govind Nagar, Kanpur 208006. Also serves clients in Bangalore, Lucknow and across India.
- **Delivery speed:** Idea to launch in under 3 weeks; simple websites in 7–10 days
- **Free mockup:** A visual mockup or prototype within 48 hours, before any commitment
- **Payment:** Milestone-based — 30% to start, 30% at mid-delivery, 40% at launch. No hidden charges.
- **Pricing range:** ₹49,999 to ₹3,00,000+ depending on scope (websites from ₹49,999, mobile apps from ₹99,999, custom software from ₹99,999)
- **Post-launch:** 7 days of free support, then optional monthly maintenance
- **Tech stack:** React, Next.js, React Native, Flutter, Node.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Firebase, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, hosted on Vercel/AWS
- **Contact:** contact@verelios.com · WhatsApp +91 8471094125
- **Hours:** Open every day, 8am–11pm IST
- **Rating:** 5.0 stars from 23 Google reviews
- **Founded:** 2024

## Services

- [Website Development](https://www.verelios.com/services/website-development): Custom, responsive, SEO-optimized websites built with React & Next.js.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.verelios.com/services/mobile-app-development): Cross-platform iOS & Android apps with React Native and Flutter.
- [Custom Software Development](https://www.verelios.com/services/custom-software-development): ERP, CRM, APIs and automation tools, full-stack Node.js & TypeScript.
- [UI/UX Design](https://www.verelios.com/services/ui-ux-design): Research, wireframing, prototyping and conversion-focused design systems.

## Common questions

- **How long does a project take?** Most launch in under 3 weeks; simple sites in 7–10 days, complex apps in 4–6 weeks.
- **Do you build for iOS and Android?** Yes — cross-platform from a single codebase using React Native and Flutter.
- **Can I see a mockup first?** Yes, free within 48 hours, with no payment or commitment.
- **Do you help with SEO?** Every project includes free basic SEO setup — meta tags, sitemap, performance and structured data.
